evidence.note: Wide food-storage drawer left of the range is fully closed.
User is pulling the drawer outward; it is partially open.
Drawer is fully open with its contents exposed.
User is pushing the still-open drawer inward.
Drawer is fully closed again.

events.object_description: Wide upper food-storage drawer in the base cabinet left of the range

evidence.note: Left door of the upper cabinet above the range hood is closed.
User reaches for the left cabinet door.
Left cabinet door is swung open, exposing the cabinet interior.
Left door remains open.
User is moving the left door toward the cabinet opening.
Left door is closed.

events.object_description: Left door of the upper cabinet above the range hood

evidence.note: Right door of the upper cabinet is still closed while the left door is open.
User repositions near the right cabinet door after opening the left one.
Right door is now swung open; both cabinet doors expose the interior.
Right door remains open.
Right door is still visibly open immediately before closure.
Right door is closed.

events.object_description: Right door of the upper cabinet above the range hood

evidence.note: Top utility drawer beneath the air fryer is closed.
User grasps the top drawer handle to pull it open.
Drawer is substantially open and its utensils and cloths are visible.
Drawer is fully open.
Drawer remains fully open.
User finishes pushing the drawer closed.
Drawer is fully closed.

events.object_description: Top utility drawer beneath the air fryer, right of the range

notes: Open is treated as on and closed as off. The two independently manipulated doors of the upper cabinet are reported as separate events; their closing actions occur close together and the right-door closing midpoint is therefore less certain.
scene_description: A user surveys a narrow modern kitchen, then opens and closes a wide food drawer, separately opens and closes both doors of an upper cabinet above the range hood, and finally opens and closes a utensil drawer beneath an air fryer.
